description: I am a student in South Africa who is taking part of the storytelling competion with my dad. We always love to tell stories and we decided to try something new. So while my dad was the brains behind the plotline, I was the brains behind the coding!
summary: Our project is an interactive story. Throughout the story the "reader" is activley part of it, choosing what they want to do and who they want to speak to. Our story is important because its going to inspire the next generation of engineers and encourage the to pursue a career in space and maybe one day design the very spacecraft that will allow humans to travel across the cosmos.
details: Our interactive storry effectively tells the reader all about the spacecraft we have sent to space. By allowing you to choose who you speak to it makes the reader feel truly involved and as if the are part of the story. This is great because its more likely to leave a lasting impact with the reader and spark their curiosity in the world of space. To develop our project we made use of Visual Studio Code to code the main story as well as ChatGPT to create the images used in the story. When making our project we wanted to do something truly unique and we belive we have definietly achieved that goal.
